H1: forward and mathematical gradient parity first; one Adam update only if all prerequisites pass
H4: one full 32-block C5 diagnostic update only after H1 passes
H8: one update only after H4 passes
H16: one update only after H8 passes
H32: one update only after H16 passes; five diagnostic updates only after one-update pass
detach_rule: after token index i when (i+1)%H==0, and at final token; detach recurrent, convolution and key/value caches on each rank at the same global token boundary while preserving numerical values
